title: Agnus Dei II — Josquin des Prez

globalTrack.source:
# Josquin des Prez, Agnus Dei II from Missa L’homme armé super voces musicales
# One melody, read at three speeds. Each voice sings as far as its cadence.
# Strict proportional reading of the mensuration signs (3:1:2).
# See the facsimile and discussion in chapter 5 of
# https://www.collectionscanada.ca/obj/thesescanada/vol1/QMM/TC-QMM-32503.pdf
# Note names and durations checked against the Josquin Research Project (Jos0603e).
{31edo}
let cadence <- 48beat

let opening <- (@4
    D===       D===       D===       F=====     D=         F==  G    |
    A=======              A===       A=====     G=         F===      |
    E===       C=====     `A=        `A===      ....       A===      |
    G===       E=====     F=         G===       C=======
)

let continuation <- (@4
    G===       E=====     F=         G=======              ....      |
    G===       G===       G===       E=====     C=         C===      |
    ....       G===       G===       G=====     F=         E===      |
    D===       G=====     A=         B==  A     B=  G===   F  E
)

let extension <- (@4
    D===       G=======              G===       G=======             |
    F===       D===       G===       D===       G===       D===      |
    G===       ....       G===       F===       D===       G===      |
    D===       G===       D===       G===       D===       G===
)

clips.source:
# An octave above the bassus, at three times the altus speed.
fit((opening | continuation | extension), cadence)
| @1 F= ||

# A fifth above the bassus, at the slowest speed.
fit(opening - P4, cadence)
| @1 D= ||

# An octave below the written line, at twice the altus speed.
(opening | continuation | @1 D=) - P8 ||
